result.title: Direct Regression and Geometric Recovery for Event-based Spacecraft Pose Estimation
result.summary: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and dynamic range for uncooperative spacecraft pose estimation, but models trained on synthetic event streams must generalize to the noise, background activity, and contrast variation of physical sensors. We present a comparative systems study of two independently developed approaches to synthetic-to-real, event-based 6-DoF spacecraft pose estimation. The first is a modular pipeline that combines learned keypoint detection and unlabeled target-domain adaptation with geometry-based pose recovery and temporal smoothing. The second directly regresses translation and rotation from global and cropped event representations using an apparent-scale cue, physics-motivated synthetic corruptions, and feature-consistency regularization. We evaluate both systems under the same SPARK 2026 hidden-test protocol on the real-event split of SPADES, with predictions for all test frames. The results reveal a component-wise reversal concealed by the aggregate challenge score: direct regression reduces orientation error by 22.7% (1.1767 to 0.9101 rad) and obtains a 13.4% lower composite score, whereas the modular pipeline reduces relative translation error by 78.7% (0.1335 to 0.0285). Archived configurations and a qualitative failure case identify plausible explanations for these complementary error profiles, without isolating their causes. These findings motivate a testable hybrid design that combines direct orientation estimation with geometry-constrained translation recovery.

AI.brief_summary: 比较两种事件相机航天器 6-DoF 位姿估计系统：一条是学习关键点检测加无标签目标域自适应、几何位姿恢复与时间平滑的模块化流程，另一条从全局与裁剪事件表示直接回归平移和旋转，辅以表观尺度线索、物理启发的合成退化和特征一致性正则；在统一隐藏测试协议下评测，发现总体分数掩盖了分量互补——直接回归旋转误差更低，模块化流程平移误差更低。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「直接回归 vs 显式几何恢复」的互补误差剖面可供核查 latent 隐式预测与显式几何/状态瓶颈之间的分工，合成退化与特征一致性正则也可能作为视觉表征鲁棒性的训练线索。
